public_rationale: A contemporaneous readable report explicitly states that OpenAI told investors its Q1 adjusted operating income margin was negative 122%. This matches Zitron's claim. Support rests on financial reporting about investor disclosures, rather than an audited public statement.

The underlying investor documents and complete adjustments were unavailable.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI had a non-GAAP operating margin of -122% in Q1 2026.

statement.excerpt: As of Q1 2026, it has a non-GAAP operating margin of negative 122%.

our_interpretation: Non-GAAP operating margin means adjusted operating income divided by realized revenue for that quarter.
Treat -122% as a figure rounded to the nearest whole percentage point.
criteria.support_condition: A reliable disclosure or report identifies OpenAI's Q1 2026 adjusted operating margin as -122%, or matching inputs yield that rounded result.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable results on the same non-GAAP basis and for the same quarter establish a margin that does not round to -122%.
